title: 9" Solar Resin Garden Gnome
amazon_match_notes: Exact match: ASIN B0B1PKC1WM is Santa's Workshop model/MPN 30106, UPC 661565301065, 9" Solar Garden Gnome in Blue. The description, frog, gazing ball and 5x7x9 in size match Woot's listing of the same item and the brand's wholesale listing.

comparisons.notes: Santa's Workshop 9in. Solar Garden Gnome, Blue/Multi. Same description (gardener gnome, frog, gazing ball) and same 9x7x5 in size. Page data shows InStock, new condition, Add to Bag. The $89.99 'Ticketed' price was ignored.

writeup: Woot has the new Santa's Workshop 9-inch solar garden gnome (model 30106, UPC 661565301065) in blue for $25.99. The resin gardener gnome includes a frog and a gazing ball that glows in shifting colors at night, measures about 9 by 7 by 5 inches, and comes with a rechargeable AA battery. Boscov's sells the same Santa's Workshop 9-inch Solar Garden Gnome in Blue/Multi for $59.99 and shows it in stock. That is 56 percent below Boscov's price and saves about $34. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
